items.title: Write the canonical Story-relevance dynamic validation tiers execution plan
items.context: Specify current-state evidence, desired architecture, dynamic selection algorithm, impact-index generation, tier semantics, fail-closed widening, signed evidence bindings, CLI UX, rollout Stories, observability, rollback, and acceptance tests. This Story is documentation-only and must not implement the selector.
items.userSees: A single canonical Markdown plan explains how Proof-or-Stop can derive fast and intermediate validation from each Story while preserving repository-full validation as the exhaustive safety boundary.
